details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradictions. Key relationships are clearly explained: rental income growth offsets flat total rental income (S3), cost controls reduce property expenses (S4), margin expansion follows NOI growth and expense reduction (S5), privatization proceeds reduce debt and improve credit metrics (S11-S15), and non-cash charges are contextualized with offsetting gains (S9-S10). The summary flows logically from operational performance to asset valuation, deleveraging, liability management, governance, and outlook. No material repetitions or organizational issues are present. All numerical relationships are presented as standalone metrics without implying exhaustive additivity, avoiding arithmetic contradiction concerns.
